facts.statement: The system shall represent a room, an outdoor-air source, an exhaust boundary, occupant CO2 generation, a room CO2 measurement, and a feedback controller that adjusts ventilation.
facts.quote:
The system shall represent a room, an outdoor-air source, an exhaust boundary, occupant
 CO2 generation, a room CO2 measurement, and a feedback controller that adjusts ventilation.

facts.statement: The room shall be represented as a single well-mixed air volume of 100 m3.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-001 - The room shall be represented as a single well-mixed air volume of 100 m3.

facts.statement: Outdoor air shall be supplied through a controlled airflow path and room air shall leave through an exhaust path.
facts.quote:
URS-IAQ-002 - Outdoor air shall be supplied through a controlled airflow path and room air shall leave through an
 exhaust path.

facts.statement: The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air flow using measured room CO2 as feedback.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-003 - The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air flow using measured room CO2 as feedback.

facts.statement: During the approved occupied schedule, room CO2 shall not exceed 1000 ppm.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-004 - During the approved occupied schedule, room CO2 shall not exceed 1000 ppm.

facts.statement: The reference outdoor-air CO2 concentration shall be 300 ppm.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-005 - The reference outdoor-air CO2 concentration shall be 300 ppm.

facts.statement: CO2 generation shall be proportional to the scheduled number of occupants.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-006 - CO2 generation shall be proportional to the scheduled number of occupants.

facts.statement: The design occupant CO2 generation rate shall be 8.18E-6 kg/s per person.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-007 - The design occupant CO2 generation rate shall be 8.18E-6 kg/s per person.

facts.statement: The released demonstration shall support a peak occupancy of at least 12 persons.
facts.quote: URS-IAQ-008 - The released demonstration shall support a peak occupancy of at least 12 persons.

facts.statement: A numerical simulation shall demonstrate the CO2 feedback behavior over a representative daily occupancy schedule.
facts.quote:
URS-IAQ-009 - A numerical simulation shall demonstrate the CO2 feedback behavior over a representative daily
 occupancy schedule.

facts.statement: Concentration and airflow quantities shall be represented with explicit engineering units or unambiguous normalization definitions.
facts.quote:
URS-IAQ-010 - Concentration and airflow quantities shall be represented with explicit engineering units or
 unambiguous normalization definitions.

facts.statement: The model shall distinguish physical outdoor-air flow direction from any implementation-specific source sign convention.
facts.quote:
URS-IAQ-011 - The model shall distinguish physical outdoor-air flow direction from any implementation-specific
 source sign convention.

facts.statement: Verification evidence shall record occupant count, room CO2, outdoor CO2, commanded ventilation, and physical ventilation flow.
facts.quote:
URS-IAQ-012 - Verification evidence shall record occupant count, room CO2, outdoor CO2, commanded ventilation,
 and physical ventilation flow.

facts.statement: Detailed controls tuning, the final occupancy schedule, and resolution of ambiguous wording may be established by later approved engineering records.
facts.quote:
Detailed controls tuning, the final occupancy schedule, and resolution of
 ambiguous wording may be established by later approved engineering records.
